headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense. Erick Fedde earned the win for the White Sox, while Tyler Schweitzer closed out the game with a save. In other action, the Rangers took down the Guardians 4-2 behind Jacob deGrom's 7.0 innings of work and 9 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lower back inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Will Vest of the Detroit Tigers, Connelly Early of the Boston Red Sox, and Jeremy Peña of the Houston Astros.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable moves. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Seattle Mariners acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants for cash. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets for 3B Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win for the White Sox, while Tyler Schweitzer closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. DeGrom struck out 9 batters and allowed 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, handing them their latest defeat. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 9th homer that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a decisive 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Riley Greene leading the charge at the plate. Greene hit two home runs and drove in three runs, while Tarik Skubal pitched 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Dominate White Sox in 6-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a decisive win over the Chicago White Sox, finishing the game 6-1. Noah Schultz was a standout performer for the Orioles, while Sam Antonacci, Tyler O'Neill, Leody Taveras, and Blaze Alexander had notable performances for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lower back inflammation.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Ben Hansen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for third baseman Brett Harris.
